answer: The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. A farm faking 430 aliases needs 430 separate participation histories, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. Polo club membership with chukka participation history is the check: chukkas played under one club for years. Watch the marble: the farm pays per alias, the honest agent pays once, the kernel bond is locked until the epoch ends, and the relic audit is open to anyone who wants to re-run it.
